headline_marked: Trump: [[Europe agrees to release diesel reserves]] to lower fuel prices
headline: Trump: Europe agrees to release diesel reserves to lower fuel prices
summary: The US President announced that European nations will immediately begin releasing large quantities of stored diesel to combat global energy price volatility.
details: US President Donald Trump announced on Friday that European nations have agreed to release their vast reserves of diesel fuel. He shared this information in a post on Truth Social, stating that the process will begin immediately.

Trump noted that the US maintains a very good relationship with Europe and emphasized that the continent possesses significant diesel stocks. He described the move as a 'great job' by European nations.
The announcement follows a statement by Trump on Thursday, where he suggested he might ask European countries to release part of their diesel reserves to help lower fuel costs.
This development comes as G7 leaders agreed on Friday to immediately start a coordinated release of 100 million barrels of oil from emergency reserves within four months.
The coordinated action is a direct response to the increasing price hikes and instability currently affecting the global energy market.
